claims.text: Defines runtime-supplied criteria and typed options with generation-free direct-logit readout and shared-state computation, while keeping calibration and broader semantic capability as explicit non-claims.
claims.resumeText: Designed typed decision contracts around runtime-defined options, direct-logit readout and shared-state reuse, with explicit calibration limits.

claims.text: Repository reports an RTX 3090 experiment with 21 direct typed-logit probability pairs at 1.023 s median versus a 5.332 s compact autoregressive JSON-array baseline.
limitations: Source-reported, not independently reproduced for this portfolio.

metric.context: One owned state, 21 criteria, same-model direct readout versus compact valid JSON-array output; three baseline runs. Isolates output-path cost, not semantic equivalence.
